mintAuthority.summary: At Plasma block 33896709, yzUSD has 101 active MINTER_ROLE holders: 97 accounts without bytecode and four contract accounts. Upgrades remain behind a 172800-second timelock proposed by a 4-of-5 Safe; limit/restriction parameters remain behind a 43200-second timelock associated with a 3-of-5 Safe. Both timelocks now restrict execution to their respective Safe and account 0x16ce19e4ee0165c481641c8bce0398c506dfa3ae rather than granting execution to the zero address. Collateral operations use Fordefi MPC infrastructure.

controls.label: Yuzu issuer / eligible-investor primary mint
controls.evidence: Yuzu docs state only Eligible Investors (KYC/AML/KYB screened) may mint/redeem yzUSD 1:1 with USDT0 through the protocol; once issued, yzUSD trades freely on secondary markets. The backend-to-token authorization path is not inferred from that product description.

controls.label: yzUSD MINTER_ROLE holder set (101 accounts)
controls.evidence: At pinned Plasma block 33896709, all 104 unique MINTER_ROLE grant recipients in the from-deployment Routescan census were checked with hasRole. Exactly 101 remain active, including all 40 previously recorded July holders. eth_getCode found 97 active accounts without bytecode and four contract accounts: 0x08c6f91e2b681faf5e17227f2a44c307b3c1364c, 0xb4dca8c97228befd0ce6bffd6cb8ad15a78439db, 0xf0bb20865277abd641a307ece5ee04e79073416c, 0xd8841457f2cacb395e092ef3b08bdf7860eb5016. The historical July census had 40 EOA minters; the current aggregate no longer claims EOA-only authority or reviewed contract guards.

controls.label: yzUSD upgrade timelock (48 hours)
controls.evidence: At pinned Plasma block 33896709, ProxyAdmin.owner() remains this TimelockController and getMinDelay() is 172800 seconds. Safe 0xa2a9700407934e913c840556b3d29f19cf6f203d retains PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remains held by the timelock itself. Historical July evidence recorded open execution.
